prompts.04:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new pure illustration for a black-iron starter rarity Chinese fantasy collectible game card, portrait exactly 1024x1536. References 1 and 2 are ONLY style references: use their dimensional fantasy commercial game-card visual language, anime-influenced designed forms, controlled finely rendered planes and clear silhouette. Do NOT copy their armor, weapon, dragon, pose, card frame, UI or writing. Subject: recognizable mature Guan Yu before fame, an unnamed low-rank fugitive chivalrous civilian; long dark flowing beard, narrow phoenix eyes, dignified formidable features, humble plain faded green cloth headwrap and worn green civilian robe. Broad grouped cloth folds, simple wrap construction, restrained wear at edges, NO shredded white rag strips or excessively patched costume. Powerful but believable civilian build. BRIGHT READABLE character and face against restrained deep blue atmosphere, carefully designed light and shadow. This is polished illustrated fantasy, NOT a movie still, photorealism, oil painting, impasto, patchy brush texture or flat cartoon. NO armor, crowns, general regalia, gold costume trim, horse, weapons, bean stall, baskets of beans, UI, border, text or watermarks. No dragon figure or monster at all; atmosphere only.
Scene and composition: Dusk ferry dock. Medium-full composition with Guan Yu seated low on a weathered wooden dock step, torso leaning just enough to tie the cloth fastening of one worn boot, both hands naturally engaged near the raised ankle. A simple cloth travel bundle rests beside him. His head is lifted in calm vigilance looking across the water, face unobstructed and strongly readable, long beard falling in one organized dark shape. Show his seated whole silhouette and both feet with breathing room. Quiet river, faint ferry silhouette and mooring post recede into layered dark indigo mist. Cool reflected water fill and small warm dusk light make his green clothes and warm face luminous. Strong diagonals of dock boards, restrained environment. No deity grandeur.
